statements.text: Once you get their voice, once you get their image — just off of television or whatever — you can go in and reconstruct it, make it look like they said anything or did anything. There's certainly a lot of danger in that. But I would submit to you that under our current laws, if someone were to engage in that kind of activity … it probably goes along with slander and libel.

statements.text: America's adversaries are investing heavily in emerging technologies, and we cannot afford to fall behind. This bill supports the Army in preparing for the technologies that will define the future of national defense. By maintaining America's technological edge, we can strengthen our cyber capabilities and ensure our military remains the most capable fighting force in the world.

statements.text: The next technological shift is already underway. While artificial intelligence is getting much of the attention, quantum technology could fundamentally change how our military communicates and protects sensitive information. Quantum technology is more than just quantum computers. It includes quantum sensing, quantum networking and quantum-enabled artificial intelligence.
